# Rainbow Day Care Centre

> Rainbow Day Care Centre is a safe, nurturing elderly day care facility in Kothrud, Pune, India. Founded by Anuradha Karkare, it provides structured daily activities, nutritious meals, health monitoring, and compassionate companionship for senior citizens — giving families peace of mind while their elderly loved ones socialise, learn, and stay active with their peers.

Rainbow Day Care Centre operates Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. It also offers Sobati, a specialized geriatrics and palliative care OPD service for the elderly and their families.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rainbowdaycarecentre.org): Main landing page with services overview, testimonials, team details, FAQs, and contact form
- [Gallery](https://rainbowdaycarecentre.org/gallery): Photo gallery showcasing amenities, daily activities (art, music, drama, games, picnics, festivals), and happy members
- [OPD — Sobati](https://rainbowdaycarecentre.org/opd): Specialized geriatrics and palliative care outpatient department offering physical care, emotional support, social connection, and spiritual comfort

## Services

- Daily Activities: Structured routines including art and craft, music, dance, drama, games, and cultural celebrations
- Compassionate Staff: Trained caregivers providing loving support and companionship
- Safe Environment: Secure, mobility-friendly space promoting comfort and well-being
- Nutritious Meals: Freshly prepared, healthy meals tailored to individual dietary and medical needs
- Health Monitoring: Regular assessments and continuous monitoring to ensure optimal wellness
- Transportation Services: Safe and reliable pick-up/drop-off assistance across select areas in Pune

## Sobati — Palliative Care OPD

- Physical Care: Managing pain and distressing symptoms to improve quality of life
- Emotional Support: Psychological counselling and mental wellbeing services
- Social Connection: Community and caregiver support networks
- Spiritual Comfort: Ensuring peace and dignity at every stage of life

## FAQ

- What services do you provide for seniors?: Comprehensive elderly day care including daily structured activities like art, music, and games, nutritious meals tailored to dietary needs, continuous health monitoring by trained staff, and a safe environment for socialisation.
- How do I enroll my loved one?: Schedule an initial visit by calling 8605003575 or filling out the online contact form on the website.
- What are your operating hours?: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, with flexible scheduling options.
- Is transportation assistance available?: Yes, safe and reliable transportation across select areas in Pune.
- Are meals provided at the center?: Freshly prepared, nutritious meals and snacks daily, tailored to dietary and medical needs.
- What safety and medical measures are in place?: Dedicated trained caregivers, continuous health monitoring, emergency response protocols, and a secure, mobility-friendly environment.
